meta.title: Which episodes are watched most, and how much is completed?
meta.question: Rank episodes by distinct viewers over the complete available coverage period; measure actual unique playback coverage.
meta.author: Codex

items: Checks refer to the numbered JSONL evidence files; requests preserve complete SQL.
Completion measures unique position coverage within seven days, not playback time or a claim that someone watched continuously.
Viewer
A distinct identified user who started a view of an episode during the period.
Completion
At least 90% unique episode coverage within seven days of first start, among eligible user-episodes.

blocks.text: Skybound episode 3 leads with 3,738 viewers and 8,014 view attempts. Of 3,571 eligible viewers, 1,012 (28.3%) reached 90% coverage within seven days; their mean unique coverage was 54.2% (check 5).

items: The 12 most-viewed episodes are all Skybound. The top ten have completion rates from 28.3% to 30.1% (check 5).
Across all titles, 35,017 of 105,989 eligible user-episodes completed: 33.0%. Mean coverage was 53.37% (check 6).
Series 3 episode 13 ranks 13th with 1,463 viewers but zero of 1,455 eligible starts completed. Every eligible case covered 25% to under 50%; the reason is unknown (checks 5, 9).
Full documented UTC coverage: April 1 through September 30, 2026. Rankings use distinct viewers per episode, not sums of monthly distinct counts; view attempts include repeat viewing.

Engagement group v1.0: completion counts each user and episode once at first start; merge overlapping playback positions across views started in the first seven days. Exclude windows ending after October 1 or episodes without catalog duration. Mean coverage is an explicitly labeled descriptive average of those individual fractions.
Silver user-episode grain provides episode detail; Bronze views provide period reach and attempt counts. Gold provides monthly overall context (checks 1, 5–7).
Baseline and quality: inventory, build, metadata, view coverage, segment presence and eligibility (checks 1–4, 6–8, 11–12).
H1: Popular episodes have lower completion than the overall population. Supported descriptively for the top ten: 28.3–30.1% versus 33.0%; this does not establish a cause (checks 5–6).

H2: Series 3 episode 13 has unusually low measured completion. Supported: 0/1,455 eligible; cause inconclusive, including possible playback or instrumentation issues (checks 5, 9). Stop because further causal explanation requires external product or telemetry context.
The 11th and 12th ranked episodes are Skybound 9 (2,927 viewers; 29.0%) and 11 (2,899; 30.8%). Rates use 2,747 and 2,717 eligible user-episodes, respectively (check 5).
Monthly completion ranged from 32.6% to 34.1%; monthly views rose from 30,372 in April to 38,951 in September. September completion excludes immature windows, so its cohort is truncated (check 7).

Skybound accounts for 36,610 eligible user-episodes, with 10,821 completed (29.6%); these are episode-level observations, not distinct people across the title. Series 3 has 1,381 completions among 6,249 eligible (22.1%); other title results appear in check 10.

Popularity and completion are different measures. Episode 3 leads by viewers, whereas episode 2 has more completed eligible user-episodes (1,050 vs 1,012); neither count proves preference or quality (check 5).

4,385 of 110,374 user-episodes (4.0%) lack a complete seven-day window and are excluded from completion; none lack catalog duration or carry Silver exceptions. For Skybound episode 3, 167 of 3,738 viewers are excluded (checks 5–6).

All 211,602 view records have a user and episode identifier, and all have at least one segment; metadata declares complete synthetic segment coverage. This does not independently prove perfect telemetry (checks 2, 4, 8).

Build succeeded November 9 at 11:16:56 UTC and reports the relevant independent coverage and registry reconciliations passed. Source counts for views, segments and episodes match build records; content hashes were not recomputed, so post-build content changes cannot be ruled out (checks 3, 11–12).

The build records registry SHA-256 57b21d71027782fc28c8ea7eea4eb0dd9ed18273577d81bf00eaded632ff1227, but the current file hash is 4b5b2f0e881666570ace017c06ff1bca380fff83c8dfa679317706e6a8815554. Both state engagement v1.0; exact registry equivalence is unverified. Builder hash matches.

The 90% threshold is a completion proxy, not literally 100%; coverage can include skips and repeat attempts. Activity after the first seven days is excluded. The synthetic data and declared observation window do not establish real-world behavior.

Ranking covers all starts in the period; completion excludes immature starts, so their denominators differ. Relative exposure, release availability, recommendation placement, intent and causal mechanisms were not assessed.
The repository has no Git metadata. Its observed directory and AGENTS.md modification time is November 9, 2026 20:12:48 IST; download date and commit cannot be verified.
Inspect playback and event instrumentation for Series 3 episode 13 and validate the 360–480 covered-second pattern against player logs before making a content decision.
Investigate exposure and audience mix for Skybound and compare matched cohorts before interpreting its below-average completion as a content problem.
Reconcile the build-time and current registry versions and verify source hashes before relying on this snapshot for a recurring decision.
